specialists.why: To clarify operational security controls and business continuity planning for the Policy Impact Mapper.

items.text: Will the web-based dashboard for the Policy Impact Mapper be integrated with the agency's existing Single Sign-On (SSO) and identity management systems to enforce strict access controls?
Is there a documented fallback or business continuity plan for policy officers to resume manual compliance mapping if the AI system is disengaged or offline?

items.text: Will the project team include accessibility, diversity, or social inclusion specialists during the calibration and testing of the gold standard set to ensure that policy changes affecting marginalised groups are correctly mapped?
Are there plans to conduct broader stakeholder consultations with frontline staff who rely on the accuracy of these policies before the tool is deployed beyond the POC stage?

specialists.why: To ensure compliance with National Archives of Australia guidance, which requires AI-generated outputs and metadata to be captured in an approved records management system.

items.text: Will the Policy Impact Mapper integrate directly with the agency's approved Electronic Documents and Records Management System (EDRMS) to automatically capture generated impact maps, user decisions, and metadata as Commonwealth records?
options: No, records will be exported and captured manually
